tools.name: get_best_deals
tools.description: Get today's top VPS highlights: top best-value plans, top cheapest plans, and top Seoul-region plans. Fast zero-argument overview.

tools.name: find_vps
tools.description: Find no-commitment monthly VPS plans that meet minimum specs, sorted by value index (default) or by price. Returns the best matching plan per provider unless one_per_provider is false.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: All no-commitment plans of one VPS provider with specs, prices, value index and overall rank. Accepts a provider id (e.g. "vultr") or name (e.g. "DigitalOcean").

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Compare 2-6 VPS providers: number of plans, cheapest plan, best-value plan and Seoul region availability for each. Optionally only plans meeting minimum specs.

tools.name: domain_prices
tools.description: Compare domain registrars for one extension by total cost over 1-5 years (first-year registration + renewals + WHOIS privacy) in pre-tax USD. This does not check whether a name is available.

tools.name: calculate_domain_tco
tools.description: Calculate and rank 1-5 year Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) across all registrars for a domain TLD (.com, .net, .org, .io, .ai, etc.), including renewal price hikes and WHOIS privacy fees, showing potential savings.
